role_summary: Lead digital and corporate technology across Starbucks Asia Pacific, with end-to-end accountability for digital & loyalty platforms, corporate product & delivery, Technology PMO, end-user management, service operations, and supply chain systems. Ensure alignment with global standards, drive governance and delivery discipline, and foster operational excellence across all active markets.
must_have_requirements: 12+ years of experience in digital technology, enterprise systems, or IT leadership
Proven track record leading digital platforms (e.g., loyalty, customer engagement) and corporate technology delivery
Strong experience leading PMO and portfolio governance functions
Experience working across multiple countries in a regional or global technology role
Strong leadership and stakeholder management in a highly matrixed global environment
Balance of innovation mindset and operational discipline
Commercial acumen with ownership of budgets and vendor partnerships
Customer- and partner-first mindset across digital and internal service experiences
Excellent problem-solving, decision-making, and communication skills
nice_to_have_requirements: Experience with supply chain systems and optimization
Exposure to GenAI technologies and their application for productivity improvement
Experience in the retail or franchise industry
Knowledge of Starbucks Global Licensing Framework

scoring_criteria.name: Digital Platform Leadership
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Core responsibility to lead customer-facing digital platforms like loyalty and engagement.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: No direct retail loyalty experience may be offset by platform leadership in other industries

scoring_criteria.name: Corporate Technology Delivery
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Own enterprise systems and internal platform delivery to meet business needs.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: May need to show experience with enterprise systems in complex environments

scoring_criteria.name: PMO Leadership
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Lead Technology PMO, governance, prioritization, and delivery discipline.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: If no formal PMO role, evidence of governance in project leadership is needed

scoring_criteria.name: Multi-country/Regional Experience
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Worked across multiple markets; must handle regional complexity and global alignment.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: If limited to one country, highlight regional interactions and global projects

scoring_criteria.name: Stakeholder Management & Influence
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Align regional delivery to global strategy in a matrixed environment.

scoring_criteria.name: Operational Excellence
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Ensure service desk and end-user management deliver consistent quality.

scoring_criteria.name: Innovation & Operational Balance
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Need to evolve digital platforms while maintaining reliability.
evidence_type_to_look_for: Introduced new technologies while maintaining uptime
Balanced innovation projects with risk management

scoring_criteria.name: Commercial Acumen
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Own budgets and vendor partnerships; drive cost-effective tech solutions.

scoring_criteria.name: Supply Chain Systems Experience
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Partner to deliver technology opportunities in supply chain.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: This is a plus; if not direct, show adjacent experience

scoring_criteria.name: GenAI and Advanced Tech Exposure
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Leverage GenAI to improve productivity; forward-looking tech adoption.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Not mandatory but preferred; relevant if present

summary_focus: 12+ years leading digital and enterprise technology across complex regional environments
Proven track record in digital platform strategy, PMO governance, and service operations
Expertise in aligning regional tech with global standards and driving innovation with reliability
do_not_overclaim: Do not claim direct loyalty platform experience if not specific
Avoid exaggerating budget size or vendor scope without evidence
Do not overstate PMO leadership unless you owned governance and prioritization

cover_letter_guidance.positioning: Position as a senior technology leader who blends innovative digital delivery with operational rigor, capable of navigating multi-market complexity and aligning with global frameworks.
bridge_gaps_honestly: If lacking loyalty platform experience, emphasize transferable customer engagement tech and scaling digital products
If PMO experience is informal, describe governance processes you shaped
If GenAI exposure is limited, highlight learning curiosity and any AI-related initiatives
